done_when: A new client app and an existing app that upgrades both get the call-or-event rule on the backend page, and reviews hold only new code against it.
why: The backend convention page names event files but never says when a module calls another module's public service or sends an event. The standards page covers only part of it, and the stack page already says to add a queue only when a story's New moving parts names one, so the fix adds just the answer-now versus react-after split.
